notes.title: V2.03
notes.notes: Major rewrite.  Replaced many components to improve gameplay.  Note voice files have been removed as added no value to game.  Steam achievements/stats and controller support have been removed  pending feedback on the mouse version of the game.

notes.title: Version 2 Of The Golden Cross Is Now Available
notes.notes:
A new character controller has been implemented to provide substantial improvement to gameplay in the action chapters.   RPG is now used giving Samantha the added ability to move backward and strafe right and left.   Improvements made to the virtual joystick plus a input remapper for keyboard and joystick users should improve the game experience.  


The demo has been updated so please be sure to check it out.

notes.title: Major update.
notes.notes:
Major update includes new character controller which triggered upgrades to several components.  Also added an input remapper for keyboard and controller users. 

Note this update will trigger a full game reset.

notes.title: Game fix March 2nd.
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug in chapter 1.  If you made it to the pillar room but didn't pick up all the artifacts and went back up to retrieve them part of cave did not get reset to active.   

This fix is only required your not past chapter 1.

THIS FIX WILL RESET THE GAME.
